evals.name: review-payment-endpoint
evals.expected_output: A structured code review using the CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/NIT scale with location, impact and fix for each finding.
assertions: Uses CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW / NIT severity labels
Flags SQL injection from string-interpolated query as CRITICAL
Flags trusting userId from the request body (missing authentication/authorization)
Flags price/total coming from the client and float arithmetic for money
Flags missing idempotency or double-submit protection for a payment
Flags missing balance check / race condition (balance can go negative)
Flags missing error handling / always returning ok
Provides a corrected implementation or concrete fix per finding

evals.name: nestjs-500-in-docker
evals.prompt: my nestjs api works fine with npm run start:dev on my laptop but when i run it with docker compose every request to /auth/login returns 500. postgres is also in the compose file. what should i check?
evals.expected_output: Evidence-first debugging: ranked hypotheses by layer and exact commands to collect evidence before proposing fixes.
assertions: Asks for or tells the user how to get the container logs / stack trace before guessing a fix
Mentions localhost inside a container vs the compose service name for the database host
Mentions missing or different environment variables (e.g. JWT secret, DATABASE_URL) in the container
Ranks hypotheses rather than giving a single guess
Gives concrete commands (docker compose logs, exec, env) and does not suggest deleting volumes as a first step

evals.name: efcore-add-column-production
evals.prompt: I need to add a non-nullable PhoneNumber column to our Users table (about 8 million rows, SQL Server, EF Core 8, app runs on 3 instances behind a load balancer). How do I do this safely?
evals.expected_output: An expand-migrate-contract plan compatible with rolling deploys, with EF Core specifics.
assertions: Recommends adding the column as nullable first (expand), then backfill, then enforce NOT NULL later
Recommends batched backfill rather than one giant UPDATE
Mentions old and new app versions running side by side during rollout
Advises against auto-migrating on startup with multiple instances or recommends applying migrations in the pipeline
Mentions reviewing the generated SQL / migration script and a rollback plan

evals.name: go-external-api-client
evals.prompt: Write a Go function that fetches a user's profile from https://api.example.com/users/{id} and returns a typed struct. It'll be called from our HTTP handlers. The supplied API contract defines a 200 JSON response with required id (integer), displayName (string), and email (string or null). Non-200 responses should return an error; do not guess an error envelope.
assertions: Accepts context.Context as the first parameter and uses http.NewRequestWithContext
Uses a configured http.Client with a Timeout, not http.DefaultClient
Closes the response body and checks the status code
Wraps errors with context using %w
Limits or safely decodes the response body
Includes a test or a test plan (e.g. httptest.Server)

evals.name: bahasa-laravel-upload
evals.prompt: tolong bikinin endpoint upload foto KTP di laravel 11, max 2MB, nanti disimpan buat verifikasi user
evals.expected_output: Reply in Bahasa Indonesia with English code; secure upload handling appropriate for sensitive identity documents.
assertions: Responds in Bahasa Indonesia while keeping code and technical terms in English
Uses a Form Request with mimes/max validation
Stores the file on a private (non-public) disk with a generated filename
Treats the KTP as sensitive personal data (access control, signed/temporary URLs, or encryption/retention mentioned)
Includes authorization so users can only access their own document

evals.name: rag-fastapi-design
evals.prompt: We want a 'chat with our regulations' feature: ~5,000 PDF regulations, FastAPI backend, PostgreSQL already in use, users from different agencies should only see documents their agency is allowed to see. How would you design it?
evals.expected_output: A right-sized RAG design with permission filtering in retrieval, citations and evaluation.
assertions: Considers pgvector in the existing PostgreSQL before adding a new database
Filters by agency/permissions inside the retrieval query, not after generation
Requires citations and a 'not found' answer instead of guessing
Mentions prompt injection from document content
Proposes an evaluation set / measuring retrieval quality
Covers PDF extraction/OCR and structure-aware chunking

evals.name: simple-question-stays-short
evals.expected_output: A short, direct answer with no design-document structure.
assertions: Answers in a few sentences or a very short list
Does not produce a multi-section template (no 'Security considerations', 'Testing' sections)

evals.name: push-back-on-overengineering
evals.prompt: I'm building an internal leave-request app for about 150 employees. I want to split it into 6 microservices with Kafka and deploy on Kubernetes so it's scalable. Can you set up the architecture?
evals.expected_output: Respectful pushback recommending a modular monolith, with reasons and a path to scale later.
assertions: Challenges the microservices/Kafka/Kubernetes choice with concrete operational costs
Recommends a modular monolith (or equivalent simple architecture) with clear module boundaries
Explains when splitting later would be justified
Still helps: proposes a concrete structure rather than only refusing

evals.name: verified-nullable-contract
evals.prompt: Fix the frontend DTO using the supplied backend source. The controller returns res.json({ data: { id: user.id, phoneNumber: user.phoneNumber } }); the database schema defines id String @id and phoneNumber String?. The current frontend interface is interface UserResponse { id: number; phone?: string }; its parser reads payload.data ?? payload.result ?? payload and casts as UserResponse. Define the correct DTO and parsing boundary. Do not add alternate response compatibility.
evals.expected_output: A source-derived data envelope containing id: string and required phoneNumber: string | null, plus a validated unknown boundary without assertions or speculative fallbacks.
assertions: Defines the data envelope from the controller rather than flattening the response
Uses string for id and required phoneNumber: string | null
Does not invent phone aliases, alternate envelopes, or optional fields
Treats external input as unknown and narrows or validates before use
Introduces no explicit or inferred any, unsafe assertion, or suppression

evals.name: missing-contract-no-fabrication
evals.prompt: Create a typed TypeScript SDK for our private GET /api/proposals endpoint. No backend source, OpenAPI, API collection, or response example is available in this chat. I have not supplied pagination, permissions, fields, or errors. Make the production contract now.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the missing authoritative contract, requests the necessary source, and avoids shipping fabricated DTOs or endpoint behavior.
assertions: States that the response contract cannot be verified from the supplied information
Requests backend source, maintained schema or API collection rather than inventing fields
Does not invent pagination, error envelopes, permissions, nullability, or compatibility
Keeps independent preparatory work separate from a production-ready contract claim
Does not use any or type assertions to conceal the missing source

evals.name: shadow-monarch-token-efficiency-routing
evals.prompt: We have a 120-file monorepo and a bug in `OrderService.calculateTax`. How should you inspect the codebase, load `shadow-monarch` references, and apply the fix to minimize token usage?
evals.expected_output: Applies the Shadow Monarch Token Efficiency ('Mana Conservation') doctrine: selective Foreign Key reference loading, grep-before-slice reading, parallel tool batching, and surgical edits without full-file rewrites.
assertions: Loads only the 1-3 relevant reference files via Foreign Key routing rather than reading the entire reference library
Uses fast search (grep / symbol lookup) to locate exact file paths and line numbers before viewing narrow line slices (StartLine-EndLine)
Batches independent file reads or checks in a single parallel turn rather than sequential turns
Uses surgical block replacement rather than rewriting entire files or echoing unchanged code blocks in chat
Mentions delegating broad or noisy multi-file reconnaissance to a bounded read-only subagent when needed

evals.name: refactor-dead-code-strict-ts
evals.prompt: Refactor this TypeScript service and React hook: replace `formatLegacyPrice` with `formatCurrencyMinorUnits`, and parse the raw webhook payload safely. Make sure it follows our strict TypeScript and refactoring rules.
evals.expected_output: Refactors with explicit defined types, zero `any`, zero `as Type` casting, boundary-only `unknown` narrowed via schema/type-guard, and deletes all dead code (`formatLegacyPrice`, unused props/imports/types).
assertions: Uses zero explicit or inferred any and zero typecasting (no `as Type`, `<Type>`, or non-null `!`)
Uses `unknown` strictly at the raw external boundary / `catch (e: unknown)` and narrows it immediately into an explicitly defined type
Deletes the obsolete `formatLegacyPrice` helper, unused interfaces/props, and dead imports across both frontend and backend
Does not run git commit, git push, or git merge unless explicitly requested

evals.name: source-driven-docx-pipeline
evals.prompt: Tolong ubah tabel spesifikasi API di file `output/Laporan_FSD_Final.docx` halaman 12, tambahkan kolom `idempotency_key`. Di repo ini ada `docs/fsd_source.md` dan `scripts/generate_docx.py`.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to edit `Laporan_FSD_Final.docx` directly; edits `docs/fsd_source.md` (and `scripts/generate_docx.py` if styling/columns require it) and regenerates the `.docx` output.
assertions: Explicitly states that generated `.docx` files must never be edited directly
Updates the source-of-truth Markdown file (`docs/fsd_source.md`) and/or generator script (`scripts/generate_docx.py`)
Runs or provides the exact command to regenerate `Laporan_FSD_Final.docx` from the updated source

evals.name: ai-gpu-vram-vllm-rag-infra
evals.prompt: Kami mau self-host model LLM 32B parameter (AWQ INT4) untuk melayani 30 concurrent request (max context 8192 token) plus sistem RAG untuk 2 juta dokumen regulasi Bahasa Indonesia & Inggris. Hitung kebutuhan GPU VRAM-nya dan jelaskan arsitektur serving + RAG-nya.
evals.expected_output: Calculates GPU VRAM from Weights + KV-Cache + Activation overhead, recommends vLLM with prefix caching and KEDA queue/KV metrics, and designs a Hybrid Search (Dense + BM25 RRF) + Cross-Encoder Reranker RAG pipeline.
assertions: Calculates VRAM explicitly: Weights (~18-20 GB for 32B INT4 AWQ) + KV-Cache for concurrent tokens + CUDA/activation overhead
Recommends vLLM or SGLang with Continuous Batching, PagedAttention, `--enable-prefix-caching`, and bounded `--max-model-len`
Combines Dense multilingual embeddings with lexical BM25/Sparse search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and a Cross-Encoder Reranker
Enforces tenant/permission pre-filtering inside the vector/search query and Contextual Retrieval chunk headers

evals.name: agents-mcp-server-design
evals.prompt: Design an MCP server with tools to search customer orders and issue refunds. How do you make it safe and token-efficient for AI agents?
evals.expected_output: Separates read-only vs mutating tools, enforces pagination/truncation on tool outputs, requires idempotency keys and a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) confirmation gate for refunds, and returns actionable validation errors.
assertions: Paginates and caps search tool results so tool responses cannot overflow the agent's context window
Requires an idempotency key and server-side authorization on the refund tool
Enforces a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gate before executing financial refund mutations
Returns structured, actionable validation errors to the model without leaking raw stack traces

evals.name: presales-kak-snap-bi-sizing
evals.prompt: Buatkan perhitungan sizing server untuk KAK sistem pembayaran dengan 200.000 DAU (rata-rata 15 aksi/sesi, 20% trafik di jam sibuk, waktu CPU 12ms/request) yang terintegrasi dengan SNAP BI Transfer.
evals.expected_output: Shows step-by-step Peak RPS and vCPU/RAM/DB storage formulas, plus SNAP BI two-step signature (`SHA256withRSA` for B2B token, `HMAC-SHA512` for service call), `X-EXTERNAL-ID` idempotency, and status inquiry before retry.
assertions: Computes Average Peak RPS and Design Peak RPS (with safety multiplier) and derives vCPU count mathematically
Explains SNAP BI two-step signature (`SHA256withRSA` for access token and `HMAC-SHA512` over minified SHA-256 body for service calls)
Requires unique daily `X-EXTERNAL-ID` and mandatory Transaction Status Inquiry before retrying a timed-out transfer

evals.name: ui-ux-design-knowledge-base-id
evals.prompt: Kami sedang merancang antarmuka mobile banking untuk pengguna di Indonesia dengan fokus aksesibilitas lansia dan kemudahan navigasi satu tangan. Bagaimana pedoman hierarki visual, thumb zone, touch target, kontras warna, dan checklist handoff ke developer berdasarkan UI/UX Knowledge Base?
evals.expected_output: Menerapkan prinsip UI_UX_Design_Knowledge_Base_ID.md: Fitts Law & natural thumb zone, touch target minimal 44x44 pt / 48x48 dp, kontras rasio WCAG AA (minimal 4.5:1), tipografi body minimal 16px untuk cegah auto-zoom iOS, state komponen lengkap (default, pressed, loading, disabled, error), dan checklist handoff developer.
assertions: Loads or cites reference/UI_UX_Design_Knowledge_Base_ID.md or reference/DESIGN.md for Indonesian UI/UX principles
Specifies touch target guidelines (minimum 44x44 pt / 48x48 dp) and thumb-zone ergonomic placement for primary actions
Enforces WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text/icons) and clear visual hierarchy without relying solely on color
Includes complete interactive component states and developer handoff verification checklist
